wow_eccentric: center hole off-center (variation increases toward the inside)
wow_constant: constant: more likely the platter or the drive
reason_other_side: The recording does not match this master, but it matches the master of side {side}: wrong side played or labels swapped.
reason_no_match: The recording does not match this master: a different record, a different side, or too little music recorded.
warn_polarity_inverted: Polarity: inverted. Both channels are inverted relative to the master. This can happen anywhere in the chain (cut, cartridge, phono preamp) and is audible at most in a direct comparison.
warn_polarity_left: Polarity: left channel inverted. One channel is inverted relative to the master: bass and center content partly cancel and the stereo image becomes diffuse. Check the cartridge connections and cables first; otherwise it is in the cut.
warn_polarity_right: Polarity: right channel inverted. One channel is inverted relative to the master: bass and center content partly cancel and the stereo image becomes diffuse. Check the cartridge connections and cables first; otherwise it is in the cut.
warn_channels_swapped: Channels swapped: left on the vinyl is right in the master. Check the cables and cartridge connections; otherwise it is in the cut.
warn_eccentric: Wow per revolution up to ±{wow:.2f} %, increasing toward the inside: center hole about {ecc:.2f} mm off-center.
warn_ends_early: The recording ends {s} s before the end of the music in the master.
warn_starts_late: The recording starts only after the music in the master has begun.

warn_pre_echo.one: Pre-echo in {n} gap, strongest {db:.0f} dB relative to the music: audible before quiet entries.
warn_pre_echo.other: Pre-echo in {n} gaps, strongest {db:.0f} dB relative to the music: audible before quiet entries.
